---
title: "Welcome"
---

## About this book

These vignettes walk through preprocessing 10X Chromium single-cell
multiome (ATAC + Gene Expression) data for an organism that 10X does not
ship a prebuilt reference for, using zebrafish (*Danio rerio*) with Lawson
Lab annotations as the worked example.

The assay chemistry is species-agnostic. What is not provided out of the
box is the reference infrastructure: Cell Ranger ARC ships prebuilt
references for human and mouse only. Everything downstream of that has to
be built, and its quality is bounded by the annotation available for your
organism. That is the problem these chapters work through.

## How to read this

Chapters are meant to be read in order. Each one assumes the decisions
made in the ones before it.

## Reproducibility

Rendered output is cached with Quarto's `freeze` so that chapters
containing long-running steps are not re-executed on every build. Package
versions used to generate each chapter are printed at the end of that
chapter.
